component.name: DeckReader
component.summary: Controller-friendly e-book reader for Steam Deck and SteamOS

description.p: A lightweight EPUB reader designed for the SteamOS game mode, companion to Deck Video Player: browse your book folders and read entirely with the Steam Deck controls.
Beta software, not yet tested on a Steam Deck, provided without any warranty.

ul.li: EPUB 2 and 3 with real book typography: hyphenation, justification, embedded images
Two pages side by side on the wide screen, one page when the text is large
OLED black, OLED dark, sepia and day themes, switched instantly
Literata, Inter and Atkinson Hyperlegible fonts; size, spacing and margins
Contents, bookmarks, and a left-stick scrub through the whole book
Reading position saved on every page turn, safe against sleep and power loss
Library from ~/Books and the microSD card, with covers and recent books
Status overlay with chapter, pages, battery and clock

description.p: First version: local library, reader, themes, contents and bookmarks.
